title: Check if Array is Good
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine if it matches the permutation of base[n], where base[n] is an array of length n+1 containing 1 to n-1 exactly once, plus two occurrences of n.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine if it matches the permutation of base[n], where base[n] is an array of length n+1 containing 1 to n-1 exactly once, plus two occurrences of n. Return true if nums is a permutation of base[n], otherwise return false.
constraints: Let n be one less than nums length.
The array is good when it contains each value 1 through n-1 once and value n exactly twice.
Return whether nums has precisely that multiset.
hints: The required multiset is uniquely determined by the array length.
Set n=len(nums)-1 and construct 1 through n followed by one extra n.
Compare that target with sorted nums.
Sorted equality is equivalent to exact equality of every required value count.
editorial: Sorted equality is equivalent to exact equality of every required value count.

tests.explanation: Here n=2, but the required multiset is [1,2,2], so the array is not good.
Here n=3 and the sorted values are exactly 1,2,3,3.
